title: heteranthera gardneri
intro: Heteranthera gardneri, commonly known as Indian water chestnut, is a floating aquatic plant native to South America. The plant is known for its edible corms, which are rich in nutrients and have various health benefits, including being a good source of carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals. The bioactive constituents of Heteranthera gardneri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant therapeutic actions, potentially aiding in the treatment of various diseases. Research on the plant suggests that it may have potential therapeutic applications, including reducing inflammation and oxidative stress, although more studies are needed to confirm its efficacy.
